description.value: Fantails Espresso Bar is a specialty coffee shop in Kimberley's Platzl, founded by Jules, a New Zealand-trained barista who set out to bring Kiwi espresso culture to the Kootenays. The bar sources organic beans from Vancouver-based AGRO roaster and serves premium first-harvest ceremonial-grade matcha from Kyoto, alongside locally baked treats. The business also operates a converted 1988 US postal service truck for seasonal events around the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the permanent location at 150 Deer Park Ave in Kimberley's Platzl, corroborating the OSM address. Vegan and GF items are explicitly listed (GF macaroons, Rebel Chocolate vegan cocoa, multiple plant milks), and the counter-service espresso bar format alongside the mobile truck operation supports takeout as true. OSM tags the name as 'Fantails Expresso Bar' with the misspelling 'Expresso'; the website consistently uses the correct spelling 'Espresso' throughout — flagged in concerns.
concerns: Name spelling mismatch: OSM records 'Fantails Expresso Bar' (misspelled 'Expresso') while the website consistently uses 'FANTAILS ESPRESSO BAR' with the correct spelling 'Espresso'.
No phone number present in OSM or on the website; only contact is email (fantails.espresso@gmail.com).

Location page states 'Truck will be running just for events this year' — the mobile espresso truck is event-only and distinct from the permanent Platzl location; OSM record represents the fixed address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active espresso bar at a confirmed address in Kimberley's Platzl with a current, content-rich website and no indicators of closure.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: GF macaroons listed among baked goods; Mocha and Hot Chocolate use Rebel Chocolate vegan liquid cocoa; full range of non-dairy milks offered (oat, soy, almond, macadamia, coconut, pistachio)

wow_evidence: founded by Jules, a New Zealand-trained barista who set out to bring Kiwi espresso culture to the Kootenays
